description: A strict machine: `on Close ignore` and the machine body's guarded `on Knock … ignore` take their events and do nothing (an `event` record and a `transition` record with no target, not `dropped`); an invoke outcome and a timer expiry whose guards fail are dropped, as in any machine; `Opened`'s `on Knock ignore` is taken before the machine body's guarded one; and back in `Closed`, a quiet `Knock`, which enables no transition, ends the run with an `unhandled` defect naming the input, which cancels the new invoke and timer and writes no `dropped` record.
